request.checkpoint: 1 - Review pins/bookmarks, reviewed-file local state, namespacing, and eviction caps

validation_results.command: cd term-control-center && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/diffReviewState.test.ts tests/diffState.test.ts tests/termBasePath.test.ts

notes: State is namespaced by repository + branch + issue number from the diff response.
Pins persist only path, line range, side, type, optional user note, and timestamps.
Reviewed entries persist only path, SHA-256 fingerprint, and timestamps; raw hunk text is used in memory for fingerprints but is not stored.
Mark reviewed is enabled once the selected file fingerprint is available; hide-reviewed affects the file rail only.
Patch rendering was split to keep DiffInspector under the repo KISS file-size guideline.
